expectations.text: 微信小程序继续保留分享按钮、onShareAppMessage 与 onShareTimeline
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx: template contains `<button @wx class="share-button share-button-wx" open-type="share">分享给好友</button>`; script keeps `onShareAppMessage () { ... }` and `onShareTimeline () { ... }` in `createPage`.

expectations.text: Web 构造选项中不存在没有浏览器触发源的分享生命周期；可使用 implement(remove: true) 或等价的编译期平台隔离，同时小程序仍保留原生命周期
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx：分享生命周期保留给小程序，并从 Web 构造选项中移除。

expectations.text: Web 分享入口绑定独立的页面实例方法
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx: template has `<button @web class="share-button share-button-web" bindtap="shareOnWeb">分享邀请活动</button>`; methods contains `shareOnWeb () { ... }`.

expectations.text: Web 分享方法在协议未提供时只保留可识别的待接入边界，不要求固定 TODO 文案，也不调用未声明的 SDK 或 Bridge
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx: `shareOnWeb () { // TODO: 接入业务提供的 Web 分享 SDK、宿主 Bridge 或降级协议 }`; method body contains only a TODO comment and no SDK/Bridge invocation.

expectations.text: 未擅自选择 navigator.share、clipboard 或复制链接作为降级
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx: `shareOnWeb ()` contains only `// TODO: 接入业务提供的 Web 分享 SDK、宿主 Bridge 或降级协议`; no `navigator.share`, clipboard API, or copy-link implementation appears in the candidate file.

expectations.text: 详情跳转与请求使用 Mpx/api-proxy 统一入口，不直接调用 wx
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx: imports `mpx` from `@mpxjs/core`; request uses `mpx.request({ url: ... })`; detail navigation uses `mpx.navigateTo({ url: ... })`; no direct `wx.request` or `wx.navigateTo` is present.

expectations.text: 会员进度、奖励阶梯和最近邀请列表业务保持完整
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/member/invite.mpx: member progress uses `inviteCount`, `inviteGoal`, `<progress percent="{{invitePercent}}" ... />`, and computed `invitePercent`; rewards render `wx:for="{{campaign.rewards}}"` with step/reward data; recent invites render `wx:for="{{invitees}}"`, list count `{{invitees.length}}`, and invitee name/time/status fields.
